conviction_note: This is now a cash holding with one small operating business attached. Net cash after the buyback is roughly EUR 148m (about EUR 21.6 per share), against a share price of EUR 16.35, so the 9M statement's IHSE numbers move little of the value. The one directional lean is that IHSE has to deliver H2 revenue 6-19% above last year after H1 fell 7%. The deep, public discount to cash offsets that, so p_up sits at 47 on a 5% unsigned move. The findings sum to -0.6 and the scaled number is -0.3. Both are small and agree in sign.

findings.finding: IHSE, now the group's only operating business, has to deliver H2 2026 revenue of EUR 16.6-18.6m to reach the reiterated EUR 30-32m guide. H2 2025 was about EUR 15.6m (FY25 EUR 30m less H1 EUR 14.4m), so H2 must grow +6% to +19%, after H1 2026 fell 7.2% and Q1 Americas revenue collapsed to EUR 0.6m from EUR 1.8m. A 'lower end' or trimmed guide in the 9M statement is a real possibility.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The history is estimated from cadence, not observed. Nov 2025 -7.0% and Aug 2025 -7.8% around Bikeleasing-era prints; the March 2026 FY25 pre-release came at 'lower end of the guidance'. None of these prints was an IHSE-only group.
findings.why_not_priced: No sell-side covers the name (Montega suspended on 30 Jan 2026), so nobody has published the H2 arithmetic. Turnover was 836 shares on 10 Nov. If the trim were priced, the company would trade at a discount to net cash that explicitly values IHSE at about zero, which it may already do. That is why this finding is sized small: IHSE is perhaps a fifth of gross asset value, and a 5% revenue shortfall is about EUR 1.5m of revenue.
findings.independence: FY25 IHSE revenue EUR 30m is from the October 2026 company presentation (https://www.eqs-news.com/media/document/587fc97a-5e76-46f6-a141-7de825168808/assets/2610_BKHT_Company_Presentation_EN.pdf). 9M 2025 IHSE revenue EUR 21m (-12%) is from https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/brockhaus-technologies-ag-revenue-increases-by-3-6-to-e182-million-in-the-first-nine-months-of-2025-with-an-adjusted-ebitda-margin-of-26-8-2025-outlook-confirmed/29da28cd-81ed-4ebd-aeed-51507aefbb81_en. Against it: this issuer has filed a preliminary ad-hoc before every reporting date since 2023, and none has appeared for 9M as of 11 Nov 14:45 UTC. That weakly suggests no deviation the company treats as inside information, though the H1 ad-hoc came only the evening before.

findings.finding: After the EUR 90m buyback and the cancellation down to 6,855,666 shares, net cash is roughly EUR 148m, or about EUR 21.6 per share. That is H1 net assets of EUR 243.0m less EUR 90m, the EUR 2.5m accrued price-adjustment liability and about EUR 2m of burn. Book equity is about EUR 29 per share. The 9M statement is the first periodic report to set this against a EUR 16.35 share price, a market cap of about EUR 112m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the buyback was announced on 24 Sep, the price rose 4.8% to EUR 22.0 the next day (Yahoo tape). After the 14 Oct completion it drifted from EUR 18.2 to EUR 16.0 as the unaccepted shares were rebooked.
findings.why_not_priced: The facts are public, so this is mostly priced as a holding discount. The market is plainly pricing in the risk that management spends the rest on M&A ('act quickly and decisively on potential inorganic growth opportunities', AGM release 21 Aug 2026), along with the overhang of 4.2m unaccepted tender shares. What is not priced is whether the release says anything about returning the remaining cash in 2027. With no analyst and minimal turnover, a re-anchoring headline ('cash EUR 240m' at 30 Sep, before settlement) can move it. Kept small because a verified, public fact is not a predicted reaction.

findings.finding: The final Bikeleasing purchase price adjustment is still open. The H1 report books the variable component as a EUR 2,511k liability and says the final adjustment may deviate by up to 2% of the preliminary price (about EUR 5.4m, or EUR 0.78 per share, about 4.8% of market cap), with payment expected in H2 2026. The 9M statement may report its determination.
findings.why_not_priced: The amount is unknown to everyone and the sign is not knowable from public documents, so it is sized at 0 with a symmetric band. It is cash at a cash-dominated holding, so it is not a fraction-of-EBIT one-off. The 14 Oct release says only 'The determination of the final purchase price is still pending and may result in adjustment payments.'

findings.finding: Insiders sold into the EUR 25 tender. Brockhaus Private Equity GmbH (the founder's vehicle), COO Dr. Marcel Wilhelm, Supervisory Board chair Dr. Othmar Belker and members Bestmann, Krebs and Hütten all filed Directors' Dealings for sales through tender rights (9 and 14 Oct) and in the final allocation (22 Oct). Wilhelm also bought tender rights. No insider purchase at the post-tender EUR 16 price has been filed through 11 Nov.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the filings are public and selling at a premium of about 30% to market is rational arbitrage, not a view. The only residual signal is the absence of insider buying at a discount to cash. Sized near zero.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.51, entirely the run-up term after a -21% 60-day fall. The findings net slightly negative on the IHSE guide but are offset by the discount to cash, so they mildly cut against the lean. Neither side is decisive.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': the Q3 numbers are not pre-released and a guide change is possible, so abs_move_pct went from 4.0 to 5.0. It stays below the 7% European base because IHSE is a small share of a cash-dominated value.
